extracted.name: Uncooked Banana Pudding
extracted.description: Quick and easy banana pudding with sour cream, milk, pudding mix, bananas, and whipped topping. No standing over a hot stove, just stir, layer, and serve.
ingredient_lines: 1 (8 ounce) container frozen whipped topping, thawed
1 (5 ounce) package instant vanilla pudding mix
instruction_lines: Stir milk, sour cream, whipped topping, and pudding mix together in a bowl until well combined.
Place a layer of cookies in the bottom of a trifle bowl; cover with a layer of pudding mixture, then a layer of bananas. Repeat until all ingredients are used.
